title: Must Experience with a Tour Guide!
text:
don’t go to the Alhambra  without taking a tour. The tour guides are so knowledgeable and elevate the entire experience. Our tour guide was Jamie, and he was so knowledgeable about the history, significance, and even pointing out small details and transporting us back in time. 
He helped us envision how the Alhambra was during the time period, how the people lived, and the significance of every structure. It was mesmerizing, and well worth it! 10 out of 10 experience and 100% recommend!
author: Aisha_A

title: Excellent historical experience
text: The tour guide exhibited profound knowledge of the history and every aspect of the Palace. Very efficient entrance to the grounds executed by the tour guide. Kept moving and reasonable pace but always giving extra time when desired.
author: Patrick_H
